# gosvizzera - Full LLM Knowledge Base

## Overview
gosvizzera delivers full-spectrum Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) and Healthcare Administrative Services tailored to medical groups, hospitals, specialty clinics, and billing management companies. Our objective is to maximize net collections, reduce denial rates below industry standards, accelerate cash flow, and ensure 100% HIPAA compliance.

## Key Solutions Breakdown

### 1. Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)
- URL: https://www.gosvizzera.com/services/revenue-cycle-management
- Features: End-to-end charge capture, patient registration, charge entry, payment posting, credentialing, financial reporting, and revenue analytics.
- Impact: Increased net revenue, reduced Days in AR (Days Sales Outstanding), transparent financial dashboards.

### 2. Prior & Retroactive Authorization
- URL: https://www.gosvizzera.com/services/prior-authorization
- URL: https://www.gosvizzera.com/services/prior-and-retro-authorization
- Features: Payer policy tracking, automated pre-auth submissions, peer-to-peer review scheduling, emergency retro-authorizations.
- Impact: Zero authorization-related claim denials, reduced administrative burden on clinical staff.

### 3. Insurance Eligibility & Benefits Verification
- URL: https://www.gosvizzera.com/services/insurance-verification
- Features: Real-time electronic verification, primary/secondary/tertiary coverage determination, co-pay/deductible calculation, pre-visit benefit checks.
- Impact: Prevention of front-desk errors and immediate reduction in eligibility denials.

### 4. Medical Coding & Audit Services
- URL: https://www.gosvizzera.com/services/medical-coding
- Features: Certified coders (CPC, CCS), ICD-10-CM/PCS, CPT, HCPCS Level II coding, E/M coding audits, modifier application, clinical documentation improvement (CDI).
- Impact: Full compliance, minimal audit risk, max reimbursement for delivered services.

### 5. Claims Management & Clearinghouse Scrubbing
- URL: https://www.gosvizzera.com/services/claims-management
- Features: Custom clearinghouse scrubbing rules, 98%+ clean claim rate, electronic remits (ERA/835), fast re-submission of rejected claims.
- Impact: Faster turnaround times (TAT) and lower cost per clean claim.

### 6. Accounts Receivable (AR) Follow-up & Denial Management
- URL: https://www.gosvizzera.com/services/ar-follow-up
- Features: Aged AR recovery (>30, >60, >90, >120 days), denial root-cause analysis, appeal letter generation, payer escalation workflows.
- Impact: Maximum recovery of uncollected revenue, reduced write-offs.

## Compliance & Security
- 100% HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act) compliant processes.
- Encrypted data transfer (TLS 1.3) and secure cloud infrastructure.
- Regular internal audits and strict role-based access control (RBAC).

## Blog & Educational Content
- URL: https://www.gosvizzera.com/blog
- Dynamic content hub published via gosvizzera's internal CMS covering RCM trends, coding updates, payer policies, and medical billing guides.
